name: agent-work-review
description: Review code changes produced by AI agents before they land — regression risk, performance defects, cloud-cost defects (Cosmos DB and other metered services), readability, repo-convention adherence — plus a goal-driven develop→review→fix loop (/work), a spec-drafting command (/draft) that writes the missing specification from codebase + goal analysis, and a findings-applier skill.
